findings: The approved card requires every position to close 15 minutes before scheduled high-impact EUR, USD, or GBP news. Source lines 22-26 disable every news mode, Strategy_NewsFilterHook is a no-op, and the generic news call at lines 241-245 is only an entry-admission return; the required pre-news position close is not implemented.

The approved rule and R2 rationale require a PSAR flip. Source lines 108-126 reads only PSAR at shift 1 and tests whether that dot is currently below/above the signal candle; it never reads shift 2 or proves the transition, so it can re-enter on later same-mode bars without a fresh PSAR flip.

The approved hard timeout is 96 completed H1 bars, but source lines 187-190 compares wall-clock elapsed seconds with 96 nominal H1 periods. Weekends and market closures advance this timer without producing H1 bars.

Strategy_ExitSignal consumes the stateful H1 QM_IsNewBar edge at line 193 while a position is open, and OnTick calls the same helper again at line 264 before entry. If an AO/AC reversal closes a trade on a bar that also satisfies the opposite entry, the second call is false and the approved mirror entry cannot be evaluated on that bar.

QM5_11899 calls QM_KillSwitchCheck before QM_FrameworkTrackOpenPositionMae at source lines 235-236. When the kill switch returns false, Q08 open-position MAE sampling is skipped, contrary to the V5 skeleton order.
